rationale: The single-element risk assessment for branch_011_012_1 indicates a secure status following a tripping event on 17 February 2024 at 12:00:00. The worst loading percent was recorded at 42.5%, with no isolated buses. The intervention cost was calculated at 48,600 CZK, based on a delta of 15 MW over 2 hours, using Natural Gas R1 with a price of 1,620 CZK per MWh.

cost.note: Illustrative: fuel-price unit x CZK_PER_PRICE_UNIT. Not a settled market price.
